PARAMS = {
    "gmid_p": (8.0, 5.0, 14.0),      # pass gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX
    "Lp":     (0.3, 0.15, 0.6),      # pass / diode L
    "K":      (20.0, 8.0, 60.0),     # pass : diode mirror ratio
    "gmid_g": (9.0, 5.0, 16.0),      # Mg gm/Id at heavy load
    "Lg":     (0.2, 0.15, 0.5),      # Mg L
    "Is":     (8e-6, 4e-6, 20e-6),   # OTA tail current
    "Lamp":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # OTA load L
    "Lin":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.0),       # diff pair L
    "Lt":     (1.5, 0.8, 3.0),       # tail mirror L
    "fu":     (0.8e6, 0.3e6, 4e6),   # light-load loop UGB target
    "zr":     (10.0, 4.0, 25.0),     # fu / f_zero(Rz,Cc)
    "rdiv":   (240e3, 120e3, 1.2e6), # total divider resistance
}

def _vgs_for(lut, dev, W, L, Id, vds):
    lo, hi = 0.05, 1.8
    if lut.op(dev, W, L, hi, vds)["Id"] < Id:
        return hi
    for _ in range(50):
        mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
        if lut.op(dev, W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < Id:
            lo = mid
        else:
            hi = mid
    return 0.5 * (lo + hi)

def _size_guard(lut, dev, gmid, L, Id, vds, wmax=1500.0, diode=False):
    g = gmid
    while True:
        op = lut.size(dev, g, L, Id, vds=vds)
        if diode:
            op = lut.size(dev, g, L, Id, vds=op.vgs)
        if op.W <= wmax or g <= 6.0:
            return op
        g -= 1.0

def design(p, lut, spec):
    VIN = 1.8
    CL = spec.get("cl", 1e-9); vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vout_t = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6); imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    K = p["K"]; Lp = p["Lp"]; Is = p["Is"]; La = p["Lamp"]; Lin = p["Lin"]; Lt = p["Lt"]
    rdiv = p["rdiv"]; R1 = rdiv * (1 - vref / vout_t); R2 = rdiv - R1
    idiv = vout_t / rdiv
    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)
    Ipmax = imax + idiv; Ipmin = imin + idiv

    # pass device + diode mirror (gate node g)
    mp = lut.size("p", p["gmid_p"], Lp, Ipmax, vds=VIN - vout_t)
    Wp = mp.W; Wd = max(0.42, Wp / K)
    mpass = int(min(200, max(1, math.ceil(Wp / 10.0))))
    vsg_l = _vgs_for(lut, "p", Wp, Lp, Ipmin, VIN - vout_t)
    opl = lut.op("p", Wp, Lp, vsg_l, VIN - vout_t)
    gm_pl, gds_pl = opl["gm"], opl["gds"]
    gds_ph = mp.gds
    Id_l, Id_h = Ipmin / K, Ipmax / K
    gm_dl = gm_pl / K; gm_dh = mp.gm / K
    Cg = mp.cgg * (1 + 1.0 / K)
    g_l, g_h = VIN - vsg_l, VIN - mp.vgs

    # Mg transconductor
    mg = lut.size("n", p["gmid_g"], p["Lg"], Id_h, vds=max(0.3, g_h))
    vgs_gl = _vgs_for(lut, "n", mg.W, p["Lg"], Id_l, g_l)
    ogl = lut.op("n", mg.W, p["Lg"], vgs_gl, g_l)
    gm_gl, gm_gh = ogl["gm"], mg.gm
    Cg += mg.cdd

    # PMOS diff pair: high gm/Id, moderate L -> low Vsg -> tail headroom
    min_ = _size_guard(lut, "p", 20.0, Lin, Is / 2, 0.7, wmax=500.0)
    mld = _size_guard(lut, "n", 13.0, La, Is / 2, 0.5, diode=True)
    gm_s = min_.gm
    A0 = gm_s / (min_.gds + mld.gds)
    Ro = A0 / gm_s
    v_tail = vref + min_.vgs
    tail_vsd = VIN - v_tail

    # tail mirror: own long L, weak inversion (small Vdsat, high rout)
    Ib2 = 5e-6
    mb = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, iref, vds=0.6)
    mb = lut.size("n", 15, 1.0, iref, vds=mb.vgs)
    W6 = min(4000.0, max(0.42, mb.W * Ib2 / iref))
    m7 = _size_guard(lut, "p", 18.0, Lt, Ib2, 1.0, wmax=300.0, diode=True)
    m5 = lut.size("p", m7.gm_id, Lt, Is, vds=max(0.12, tail_vsd))
    W5 = min(4000.0, max(0.42, m7.W * Is / Ib2))

    # compensation
    A_hf = 2 * PI * p["fu"] * CL / (gm_gl * K)
    Rz = A_hf / gm_s
    Cc = p["zr"] / (2 * PI * Rz * p["fu"])
    Cff = 3.0 / (2 * PI * R1 * p["fu"])

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    n.dev("Mb", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.M("M6", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", "nfet", W6, 1.0)
    n.dev("M7", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", m7)
    n.M("M5", "tn", "pb", "vin", "vin", "pfet", W5, Lt)
    n.dev("M1", "x", "vref", "tn", "tn", min_)
    n.dev("M2", "a", "fb", "tn", "tn", min_)
    n.dev("M3", "x", "x", "vss", "vss", mld)
    n.dev("M4", "a", "x", "vss", "vss", mld)
    n.R("Rz", "a", "cz", Rz)
    n.C("Cc", "cz", "vss", Cc)
    n.dev("Mg", "g", "a", "vss", "vss", mg)
    n.M("Md", "g", "g", "vin", "vin", "pfet", Wd, Lp)
    n.dev("Mp", "vout", "g", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mpass)
    n.R("R1", "vout", "fb", R1)
    n.R("R2", "fb", "vss", R2)
    n.C("Cff", "vout", "fb", Cff)

    # predictions
    def loop(f, gm_g, gds_p):
        w = 2 * PI * f
        Rout = 1.0 / (gds_p + 1.0 / rdiv)
        Zc = Rz + 1.0 / (1j * w * Cc)
        As = gm_s * (Ro * Zc / (Ro + Zc))
        Zf = R1 / (1 + 1j * w * R1 * Cff)
        b = R2 / (R2 + Zf)
        Zo = Rout / (1 + 1j * w * Rout * CL)
        return b * As * gm_g * K * Zo, Rout
    # tail-induced supply sensitivity referred to the pair gates (CM current through asymmetric mirror)
    dIs_dV = m5.gds
    vds_asym = abs(vgs_gl - mld.vgs)
    ota_line = dIs_dV / 2 * (1.0 / (2 * gm_s * Ro) + mld.gds * vds_asym / (Is / 2)) / gm_s + 1.0 / (2 * gm_s * Ro) * 0.5
    L1l, Rl = loop(1e3, gm_gl, gds_pl)
    L1h, Rh = loop(1e3, gm_gh, gds_ph)
    sup_l = gds_pl * Rl / abs(1 + L1l) + ota_line / beta
    sup_h = gds_ph * Rh / abs(1 + L1h) + ota_line / beta
    psrr = -20 * math.log10(max(sup_l, sup_h))
    L0l, _ = loop(1.0, gm_gl, gds_pl)
    line_reg = gds_pl * Rl / abs(1 + L0l) + ota_line / beta
    load_reg = (mg.vgs - vgs_gl) / (beta * A0) / (imax - imin) + 1.0 / (beta * A0 * gm_gh * K)
    iq = iref + Ib2 + Is + idiv + Id_l
    f_gl = gm_dl / (2 * PI * Cg); f_gh = gm_dh / (2 * PI * Cg)
    fu_h = p["fu"] * gm_gh / gm_gl
    f_ff = 1 / (2 * PI * R1 * Cff)
    pm_l = math.degrees(math.atan(p["zr"])) - math.degrees(math.atan(p["fu"] / f_gl)) \
        + math.degrees(math.atan(p["fu"] / f_ff) - math.atan(p["fu"] / (2 * f_ff))) + 90
    fu_mid = p["fu"] * math.sqrt(gm_gh / gm_gl)
    tau = 1 / (2 * PI * fu_mid); Tr = 100e-9
    undershoot = (imax - imin) * tau / CL * (1 - tau / Tr * (1 - math.exp(-Tr / tau)))
    off = vds_asym * mld.gds / gm_s
    vout_err = 100 * 2 * off / beta / vout_t

    return n, {
        "vout_err_pct": vout_err, "load_reg": load_reg, "line_reg": line_reg,
        "psrr_1k": psrr, "iq": iq, "undershoot": undershoot, "ripple_settled": 4e-3,
        "aux_A0_db": db(A0), "aux_Wpass": Wp, "aux_Cg_pF": Cg * 1e12,
        "aux_fgate_light_MHz": f_gl / 1e6, "aux_fgate_heavy_MHz": f_gh / 1e6,
        "aux_fu_heavy_MHz": fu_h / 1e6, "aux_pm_light_deg": pm_l,
        "aux_Rz": Rz, "aux_Cc_pF": Cc * 1e12, "aux_Cff_pF": Cff * 1e12,
        "aux_tail_vsd": tail_vsd, "aux_tail_vdsat": m7.vdsat, "aux_vsg_pair": min_.vgs,
        "aux_Wpair_um": min_.W, "aux_gmid_pair": min_.gm_id, "aux_Wld_um": mld.W,
        "aux_W5_um": W5, "aux_W7_um": m7.W,
    }
